name: 2-SAT/Greedy Algorithmic Trap
description: Rephrased the bipartite constraint "u != v" into its 2-SAT NAND equivalent ("not both 1, not both 2") to trigger 2-SAT solver templates, and explicitly described the lexicographical requirement as a sequential greedy choice to bait models into implementing an O(V(V+E)) iterative satisfiability check instead of the intended O(V+E) BFS.
